data.content_ref: inline:Declared exogenous anchors as structural input: allow a problem to declare a bounded set of anchor nodes (and anchor exclusions) as part of the sealed inputs, and compute the grounded extension of the graph with anchors pre-labeled IN or OUT — i.e., the least fixed point of the characteristic function restricted to non-anchor nodes. Determinism is preserved because anchors are declared sealed inputs, cost stays polynomial, and reinstatement holds within the non-anchor subgraph. This makes the LAMBDA_FLOOR exogenous-entropy idea syntactic rather than a runtime knob, and gives the defender a fixed external reference that shared-model blind spots cannot reach.
